Title: Nikhil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vimla - 74 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Pihu - 12 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Pallavi and Vimla stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil puts on his school uniform.]

Pallavi (excited): "That's easy."

[Nikhil combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Vimla: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Vimla stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil points at the sky.]

Nikhil: "And then?"

[Nikhil scratches his head.]

Nikhil: "Grandma, are you okay?"

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Nikhil: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Nikhil lights a bonfire.]

Nikhil: "Careful!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

Nikhil: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil gets off the school bus.]

Nikhil: "Yes, of course."

[Nikhil pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Pallavi: "And then?"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Nikhil, look over here."

[The mist slowly clears.]

Pallavi (gently): "What a day to remember!"
